elements.text: Light to moderate icing conditions in stable cloud layer near 0°C
Aggravation of icing by liquid precipitation (supercooled rain/drizzle)
Excessive duration of flight in icing conditions
Lack of crew communication regarding icing severity and procedures
Aircraft certification limits (FAR-JAR 25 Appendix C) did not account for supercooled droplets >40µm or freezing drizzle/rain
Crew awareness of light to moderate icing from flight release
AIRMET forecast of rainfall at flight altitude with negative temperatures
Flight in holding pattern for over 30 minutes in contradiction with certification and operational limits
Failure to respect procedures for environmental surveillance, SAT, ice indicators, and visual cues
Improper application of propeller speed adjustment and anti-icing/de-icing system activation procedures
Overall crew vigilance and awareness did not correspond to basic rules for icing conditions
